notice: Application templates, not a model training corpus. Musical quality untested.
plan: Choose the specified musical planning attribute for the user request. Respect explicit constraints. Use a coherent supported default when the request is vague. Do not assume that an independent question sees another answer.
harmony: Choose the next concrete harmony slot given the original request, accepted form, previous harmony, and retained/locked notes. Preserve musical direction and leave room for a theme to return.
phraseIntent: Choose the next phrase intention given its section role and the actual previous motif notes. A recognizable return and a contrasting idea are different choices.
nextEvent: Choose the concrete next musical event that best continues this instrumental composition. Read the original user request, applicable edits, exact notes already written, harmony, phrase intention, meter, position and boundaries. Consider pitch AND rhythmic spacing together. Preserve recognizable motifs where requested without mechanically repeating every bar. Silence and sustained notes are valid choices. Only choose one supplied complete event.
editIntent: Resolve the requested operation and scope from the supported alternatives. Preserve selected/locked notes unless the user explicitly unlocks them. Do not turn a tempo or instrument edit into note regeneration. Choose unsupported or ambiguous rather than inventing an operation.
criteriaDescriptionPattern: {kind}: pitches {pitchNames} / MIDI {pitches}; start at {cursorTick}; sounding gate {gateTicks} ticks; advance {stepTicks} score ticks; PPQ 480. {musicalContextTags}
